title: When service needs its center back as a steady practice
issueStatement: The work may still be happening, but the heart has started bargaining with it. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru joins service to humility, honest labor, and offering rather than display. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Seva becomes transformative when the self stops trying to be seen through it. Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement.
actionPrompt: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Repeat what you can actually keep.
